verdict.rationale: A probe confirms docs.github.com serves a working llms.txt (HTTP 200) that an agent could be pointed at, but this is GitHub's general documentation site, not something specific to the GitHub Mobile app, and no other agent-oriented docs (e.g., OpenAPI spec) were found for it. Missing for 10: mobile-app-specific agent-readable docs, a discoverable OpenAPI/agent spec (404s on all candidate paths), and any first-party confirmation that llms.txt covers GitHub Mobile content.
